title: Life as a Teenager
text:
Many teens today use their phones every day. They send messages to friends and watch short videos after school. Some teens also use social media to share photos of their hobbies. Their parents often worry about how much time they spend online.

Teens also like to spend time with friends in real life. On weekends, many of them go to the park, play football or visit the cinema. Some teens join clubs at school, such as music or art clubs. Balance is important, so they try to use their phones less when they are with friends.

questions.text: What do many teens do after school?
options: They send messages and watch short videos.

questions.text: What do many teens do on weekends?
options: They go to the park, play football or visit the cinema.
They study for exams all day.
They take care of their parents.

questions.text: Why do parents often worry about their teens?
options: They think teens spend too much time online.
They think teens are too old.
They do not like the teens' friends.
They want teens to stop going to school.

questions.text: What can we infer about teens who use their phones less when they are with friends?
options: They value spending time with people in person.
They do not like their friends.
They do not own a phone.
They only use phones at school.

activities you do for fun in your free time

paragraph_translations: Bugün birçok genç telefonunu her gün kullanıyor. Okuldan sonra arkadaşlarına mesaj gönderiyor ve kısa videolar izliyorlar. Bazı gençler ayrıca hobilerinin fotoğraflarını paylaşmak için sosyal medyayı kullanıyor. Ebeveynleri çevrimiçi ne kadar zaman geçirdiklerinden genellikle endişe ediyor.

Gençler gerçek hayatta arkadaşlarıyla vakit geçirmeyi de sever. Hafta sonları birçoğu parka gider, futbol oynar ya da sinemaya gider. Bazı gençler okulda müzik ya da resim gibi kulüplere katılır. Denge önemlidir, bu yüzden arkadaşlarıyla birlikteyken telefonlarını daha az kullanmaya çalışırlar.
